Workspace map

Where everything lives

Three spaces carry the day to day work. Customer Visibility is the client-facing mirror of your jobs and is filled by automation.

One code links everything. The Customer Code on every job is how automations find the client, the Zoho Books contact and the right Customer Visibility folder.

Customer Code · required on every job
Golden rules

Eight habits that keep the automations healthy

01

Move work by changing the status

Most automations fire on a status change. Writing "done" in a comment does nothing; moving the task to the next status does.

02

Never rename statuses or lists

Automations look for exact names. Renaming a status such as Qualified, or a list such as CAD Jobs, breaks them silently. Talk to your administrator before changing either.

03

Never rename a custom field

Keep every custom field name exactly as it is, for example Customer Code, Service Line, Category or Invoice Status. Automations find fields by their exact name, so a renamed field simply stops being read.

04

Never change a custom field the automations use

Do not change a field's type or edit, rename or delete its dropdown options. The automations, Customer Visibility sync and Zoho Books all depend on them. If a field must change, ask your administrator to update the automations first.

05

Fill required fields before moving on

Some steps check fields first (for example Quotation Number and Quotation Doc). If ClickBot comments that something is missing, fill it and move the status again.

06

Use the buttons, not workarounds

Sync Customer Task, Sync SKU, Files Updated and Generate Invoice start automations on demand. Press them once and wait for the confirmation comment.

07

Read the comments first

Every automation leaves a comment on the task it touched. A comment with a green tick means it worked; one with a red stop sign explains exactly why it stopped.

08

Keep client-facing fields clean

Customers can see a small set of fields on their mirror tasks (Order ID, Category, Quantity, Customer PO, CAD Image, Final Files). Write them as if the client is reading.

01
Client Management space

Client onboarding

A new client moves through four lists: Enquiries, Onboarding, Sampling (optional) and Client. Automations send the onboarding form and create the client in Zoho Books. Sample invoices are built by the team.

Lists Enquiries · Onboarding · Sampling · ClientAutomations ClickBot · n8n · Zoho BooksOwner Sales and accounts

Step by step

  1. Log the enquiryOpen the Enquiries list and submit the Lead Logging Form with the contact details, source and service lines of interest. A task is created in status new and ClickBot comments "The New enquiry has been logged."
  2. Talk to the prospectMove the task to in discussion while you are in conversation. Add notes from calls in the task activity so the history stays with the client.
  3. Qualify the leadMove the task to qualified. This is the trigger: the task moves to the Onboarding list in status onboarding invitation sent, and the onboarding form link is emailed to the client. A comment confirms who it was sent to and includes the form link.
  4. Client completes the onboarding formThe form collects business details, GST treatment, PAN / GST, addresses, currency and payment method. On submission the task moves to registered, the task description is rebuilt as a full onboarding record, and the client is created in (or linked to) Zoho Books.
  5. Decide on samplingClickBot asks you to choose. Move to send for sampling to run a sample, or add to active client to skip sampling. Then check the client is in the Client list with status active.
  6. Run the sample (if chosen)In the Sampling list: set Sample Type (Free / Paid) and the service amounts, move to generate invoice and build the invoice in Zoho Books. This step is manual; no automation creates the sample invoice. Then follow the sampling statuses below.
  7. Active clientOnce approved the client sits in the Client list as active, dormant or in active. Keep this status current; it is your client master.

Statuses by list

Enquiries

new> in discussion> qualified or lost

Onboarding

onboarding invitation sent> registered> send for sampling or add to active client

Sampling

to do> generate invoice> awaiting payment> payment recieved> awaiting brief submission> sampling> sample ready> sample sent> sample approved

Client

active dormant in active close

GST treatment matters

The onboarding form supports six GST paths: registered regular, registered composition, unregistered, individual entity, overseas and SEZ. Indian (non-overseas) clients default to country India and currency INR; overseas clients pick their own country and currency. Most rejections come from a mismatch here, see the error reference.

02
Jobs & Delivery › CAD › CAD Jobs

CAD jobs

Each task is one CAD design job. Jobs arrive from the order form with the full brief, SKU and server path already filled in, and a client-facing mirror is created in the client's Customer Visibility folder.

List CAD JobsAutomations Order form · stall timer · Sync Customer TaskOwner CAD coordinator and team leads

Status flow

todo> ready to work> work in progress> send cad image> under client review> approved> cad files ready> delivered

Side paths: client revision when the client asks for changes, needs attention when something blocks the job, and stalled when the client goes quiet.

StatusMeaningWho moves it
todoNew job created from the order form, waiting for a designer.System
ready to workBrief checked and a designer assigned.CAD coordinator / Team Lead
work in progressDesigner is modelling.Designer
send cad imageInternal review passed; CAD image ready to go to the client.Team Lead
under client reviewClient has the CAD image and is reviewing.Coordinator
client revisionClient asked for changes. Write them in Revision Notes.Coordinator
approvedClient approved the design.Coordinator
cad files readyFinal files prepared and linked in Final Files.Designer / Team Lead
stalledNo client response. Set automatically after 10 days in client review.System
deliveredJob closed. Stalled jobs close automatically after 30 days.Coordinator / System

Fields you will use most

Set by the order form

  • Customer Code (required), Order ID, Customer PO
  • Parent SKU, Child SKU, Folder Style Number
  • Server Path for the job folder
  • Category, Quantity, Order Type, Team Lead

Maintained by the team

  • Designer Statusses: Unassigned › Assigned › In Progress › TL Review › Internal Revision › Client Revision › Prepare CAD Files › CAD Files Ready › Approved › Close
  • TL Approval (Approved / Revision), Revision Notes
  • Complexity (A, B, C) and Modifications (0.25 to 1.25), used for billing
  • CAD Image and Final Files (visible to the client)
  • Rendering Required when the job continues to rendering

Why there is a Sync button

The client mirror is not updated on every edit, because that would use a large number of automation runs. After you change a field the client should see (task name, quantity, modifications, CAD image, final files), press Sync Customer Task once.

03
Jobs & Delivery › Conversion & Rendering › Rendering Jobs

Conversion & rendering

Each task is one rendering job, either from an approved internal CAD job or from a CAD file the client supplied. The file is first converted for rendering, then rendered, reviewed and shared.

List Rendering JobsButtons Files Updated · Sync Customer TaskOwner Conversion head and render team

Status flow

todo> conversion in progress> render in progress> ready to share> render sent> approved

Side paths: client mod (conversion) and client mod (render) for client changes, hold to pause, cancelled to stop.

Step by step

  1. Create or receive the jobFill Customer Code, Order Type, Rendering Complexity (Normal / Heavy), Type of Work (New Work / Re Work) and the CAD server path. Tick Conversion-Only? if no render is needed.
  2. Hand over to conversionMove to conversion in progress. ClickBot assigns the conversion head with "Please proceed with Conversion." Track the detail in the Conversion Status field: TO DO › FILE CHECKING › CONVERSION IN PROGRESS › AWAITING REVIEW › INTERNAL / CLIENT MODIFICATION › CONVERSION APPROVED. Use NEEDS ATTENTION when the CAD file has a problem and add the issue in Conversion Remarks.
  3. RenderMove to render in progress and track Render Statusses: TO DO › RENDER IN PROCESS › AWAITING REVIEW › INTERNAL / CLIENT MODIFICATION › RENDER APPROVED. If the render reveals a file problem, set CONVERSION MODIFICATION; when conversion has fixed it, press Files Updated (the Conversion MOD button).
  4. Review and shareMove to ready to share, add the deliverable links (Still Images, 360 Videos, Interactive Link URL, GLB File, Render Link) and press Sync Customer Task. Then move to render sent.
  5. CloseOn client approval move to approved and fill Render Completion Date and Delivery Date. Tick Re-Render if the client later asks for a fresh render on the same piece.
04
Jobs & Delivery › Manufacturing

Manufacturing

Manufacturing runs across three lists: the Quotation List for pricing, the Order List for production, and Purchase & Sales for costing and invoicing once a piece is produced.

Lists Quotation List · Order List · Purchase & SalesAutomations ClickBot checks and remindersOwner Accounts, procurement, production

1. Quotation List

new quotation request> quotation preparation> quotation internal review> quotation sent> followed up> quotation approved

Side paths: quotation revision and quotation expired. Before a quotation can go to review, fill Quotation Number and attach the Quotation Doc. ClickBot blocks the move with a reminder if either is missing, then asks the reviewer to review, and finally asks the account owner to send it to the customer.

2. Order List

new order> in procurement> procured> cad modification> cad ready> generate po> release po to factory> in production> qc review> ready for shipment> shipped> delivered

Use additional action required when an order is blocked and cancel to stop it.

  1. Confirm the orderFill the order spec: Order Type, metal (Metal Type, Metal KT, Metal Color), Item Size, centre and side stone fields, Findings, Engrave, Committed Shipment Date. Paste the client's notes into Special Instruction.
  2. Procure stonesMove to in procurement; set Procurement Status, Centre - Diamond Supply Type and Procurement Outcome (Exact Match / Close Alternative / Significantly Different). Tick CAD Modification Required if the stones change the design.
  3. CAD modificationIf needed, move to cad modification; ClickBot asks the CAD lead to collect the changes and track them in CAD Modification Statusses. Move to cad ready when done.
  4. Purchase order and productionMove through generate po and release po to factory, filling PO Number, Vendor and PO Server Path. Then in production; record Reason for Delays if dates slip.
  5. Quality checkIn qc review use QC Statusses (READY FOR QC › QC IN-PROGRESS › QC REPAIR / TOTAL REJECT › QC PASSED) and the QC dates.
  6. ShipSet Shipping Partner, Tracking ID, tick Tracking Shared and track Shipment Statusses. Move to shipped, then delivered.

3. Purchase & Sales

pending cost> purchase entry> po pending> invoicing> invoice> close

The purchase team records costs (ClickBot asks for gemstone costs where needed) and accounts raises the invoice, tracked in the Invoicing Stage field: NEW › INVOICE DRAFTED › INVOICE GENERATED › INVOICE SENT › PAYMENT RECIEVED.

05
Jobs & Delivery › Finance Team › Monthly Reconcilation

Monthly reconciliation

Each billing cycle, every CAD and rendering job that is billable and not yet invoiced is gathered into one reconciliation task per customer. Finance prices the lines, approves them, generates the client packing list and raises the invoice in Zoho Books. Invoiced jobs are marked so they are never billed twice.

List Monthly ReconcilationButtons Fill Category Price · Generate Packing List · Generate InvoiceOwner Finance team

Which jobs are picked up

Included

  • Jobs not yet invoiced to the client, whatever month they were created in. A job created in September that is still in progress is picked up in a later cycle once it qualifies.
  • CAD jobs from send cad image onwards, including client revision.
  • Each rendering service ordered on a job (for example Still Images or R2R Conversion) becomes its own line.

Left out

  • Jobs already marked Invoiced?. A job is never billed twice, even if the automation runs again.
  • CAD jobs in needs attention.
  • Test and cancelled entries.
  • Advance payments: tick Invoiced? on the job by hand so it is not billed again.

Step by step

  1. Check the jobs before the cycleMake sure each job has the right status and quantity: Item Count, Complexity and Modifications for CAD, and the services ordered for rendering. The reconciliation reads these values when it builds the lines.
  2. The reconciliation task is createdThe automation creates one task per customer per month, named Customer Code | YYYY-MM. Every billable job becomes a sub-order line underneath it, named service line, style and service. The task description shows a billing summary that updates as lines are priced.
  3. Price the linesEnter the Actuall Price on one line and press Fill Category Price. The price is copied to every line in the same group for that customer: the same Complexity for CAD, or the same service and Normal / Heavy tier for rendering. To change a price, edit it on one line and press the button again; only that group changes.
  4. ApproveMove the task to approved. The automation checks every line, ticks Verified and comments when all lines are approved. A line with an empty price blocks approval; a price of 0 is accepted.
  5. Generate the packing listPress Generate Packing List. A client-facing spreadsheet named Customer Code_YYYY-MM_Reconciliation.xlsx is attached to the task. If you generate it again, a new version (_v2) is attached and a comment tells you which file is current. Delete the older file by hand.
  6. Generate the invoicePress Generate Invoice. A draft invoice is created in Zoho Books with the CAD and rendering totals and GST, its PDF is attached and a comment links to it. Invoice No is filled and every job on the task is marked Invoiced? automatically. If any job could not be marked, a comment on the task lists it.
  7. Send and closeFinance reviews the draft and sends it from Zoho Books, then moves the task to complete.

Verify quantities with a filter

Before you generate the packing list, filter the reconciliation tasks to check the quantities on each line. This short walkthrough shows the filter in use.

Statuses

to do> in progress> approved> complete

How amounts are calculated

AmountFormula
CAD line(Unit price × Item Count) + (Unit price × Modification). Not rounded.
Rendering lineUnit price × Item Count. No modification applies to rendering. Not rounded.
Task totalSum of all line amounts, rounded up to the whole unit. This is the only place rounding happens.
Zero quantity, CAD0 or blank both show the line with quantity 0. Enter 0 so it is clearly intentional.
Zero quantity, renderingEnter 0 to show the service as a 0 line. A blank service is treated as not ordered and creates no line.

Invoices are drafts

Generate Invoice never sends anything to the client. Finance reviews and sends every invoice from Zoho Books.

06
Customer Visibility space

Customer visibility

Each client has a folder named by their Customer Code, with one list per service line they have ordered. A client who has only ordered CAD has just a CAD list; a client with CAD and rendering orders has both. These lists hold mirror tasks that show the client their job status in plain language, without internal fields or assignees.

Structure One folder per customer · one list per service lineAutomation Sync Customer Task (n8n)Owner Filled by automation only

CAD mirror statuses

queuedin progressawaiting your feedbackmodification in progressapprovedon holddelivered

Rendering mirror statuses

queuedin progressawaiting your feedbackrevision in progresson holdcancelleddelivered

Do not edit mirror tasks by hand

Change the internal job and press Sync Customer Task. Hand edits on the mirror are overwritten on the next sync and are not seen by the team.

Monitoring

Seeing what happened

Check in this order. Most questions are answered at step one without leaving the task.

  1. The task itself: comments and activityOpen the task and read the activity panel on the right. Every automation leaves a comment, and the activity log shows each status change, field update and who (or which automation) made it. If you expected a comment and there is none, the automation did not run for that task.
  2. ClickUp automation history (ClickBot)Open the list, click Automate (top right) and choose Manage Automations. Each automation shows whether it is on, and its activity / history view lists recent runs with success or failure. A switched-off toggle is the most common reason a reminder stops.
  3. n8n executions (forms, Zoho, Sync buttons)Sign in to your n8n instance, open the workflow (or the Executions list for all workflows) and filter by status Error. Each execution shows the time, the data it received and the node where it stopped.
  4. Zoho BooksFor onboarding and invoices, confirm the contact or draft invoice exists in Zoho Books. The task comment gives you the Zoho contact or invoice number to search for.

A useful daily check

Once a day, open n8n Executions filtered to Error for the last 24 hours. If the list is empty, every n8n workflow ran cleanly.

Reference

Error message reference

Codes you may see in stop sign comments from the onboarding and invoicing workflows.

CodeWhat it meansHow to fix it
TREATMENT_COUNTRY_MISMATCHThe GST treatment chosen does not fit the country. For example an Indian-only treatment with a non-Indian country.Ask the client to resubmit with the right GST treatment. Overseas clients must choose overseas.
MISSING_PANThe GST treatment requires a PAN and none was supplied.Ask the client to resubmit with their PAN.
MISSING_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODEThe phone number has no country dialling code and none could be worked out from the country.Resubmit with the country code (for example +91).
NO_PAN_CARD warningA PAN number was given but no PAN card document was uploaded.Not blocking. Collect the PAN card from the client for your records.
MISSING_PLACE_OF_CONTACTThe GST treatment needs a place of supply (Indian state) and none could be found from the GSTIN, the form or the billing state.Ask the client to resubmit with a valid GSTIN or billing state.
ALREADY_INVOICEDThe task already has an invoice number and Zoho Invoice ID, so a second invoice was not created.If a new invoice is truly needed, clear Invoice No and Zoho Invoice ID on the task, then press Generate Invoice again.

Invoices are drafts

Invoices raised from ClickUp are created in Zoho Books as drafts. Finance reviews and sends them from Zoho Books.

After handover

Maintaining the system

When someone joins or leaves

  • Add them to ClickUp and to the right lists.
  • Check automations that assign or tag a named person (team lead, conversion head, accounts, purchase) and update the assignee.
  • Reassign their open tasks.

When you want to change a process

  • Adding a new status or dropdown option is safe.
  • Renaming or deleting a status, field or list that an automation uses is not. Update the automation first.
  • Log change requests in To-Do › Click Up Feedback.

Keep connections alive

  • n8n holds the ClickUp, Zoho Books and email connections. Keep the account that owns them active.
  • If a password is changed, reconnect the credential in n8n.

Weekly five-minute check

  • n8n Executions: any errors this week?
  • ClickUp Automations: all expected automations switched on?
  • Stalled CAD jobs: any that need a nudge before they auto-close?
Reference

Glossary

TermMeaning
Customer CodeThe unique client code (for example DJ18). Required on every job; links ClickUp, Zoho Books and Customer Visibility.
Mirror taskThe client-facing copy of a job in Customer Visibility.
Parent SKU / Child SKUDesign reference and its variant (stone shape, size). Combined into the Folder Style Number.
ConversionPreparing a manufacturing CAD file for rendering: smoothing surfaces, adjusting stones and prongs so the render matches the final piece.
Complexity / ModificationsCAD effort grade (A hardest, B, C) and modification weight (0.25 to 1.25). Used for billing.
StalledA CAD job with no client response for 10 days in client review. Auto-delivered after 30 days stalled.
ClickBotThe name ClickUp's built-in automations use on comments.
n8n executionOne run of an n8n workflow, with its input, output and any error.
